# HogNoise

> Procedural noise for Python: the FastNoiseLite and FastNoiseSIMD algorithms in one package, rendered three ways (numba, a binding, numpy) from one parameter record and checked against committed vectors from the originals. 2D and 3D only; no GPU rung and no 4D yet. Pre-release.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): why it exists, what it covers, what it is not, how to trust it
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for working in this repository
- [PROVENANCE.md](PROVENANCE.md): where the code came from and what was changed

## Evidence

- [tests/vectors/noise/portability.md](tests/vectors/noise/portability.md): every comparison, with its largest difference
- [Docs/noise/GALLERY.md](Docs/noise/GALLERY.md): every noise type rendered
- [Docs/decisions/ADR-007-noise-kernels-port.md](Docs/decisions/ADR-007-noise-kernels-port.md): why a port, and the measurements behind the choice
